expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Returns the current project's user-specific directory. Returns the current project's Content directory. Returns the current project's Config directory. Returns the current project's Saved directory. Returns the current project's Intermediate directory. Returns the directory used for screenshots. Returns the directory used for captured video. Replaces the final extension of InPath. Splits a path into directory, base filename, and extension outputs. @param PathPart Receives the directory portion. @param FilenamePart Receives the base filename without extension. @param ExtensionPart Receives the extension without its leading period. Reports whether InPath names an existing file.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Explicit arguments for every overload, default-argument omission where published, and valid/null context variants when handles or WorldContext are involved.
testScope: FString FPaths::ProjectUserDir(); | FString FPaths::ProjectContentDir(); | FString FPaths::ProjectConfigDir(); | const FString& FPaths::ProjectSavedDir(); | FString FPaths::ProjectIntermediateDir(); | FString FPaths::ScreenShotDir(); | FString FPaths::VideoCaptureDir(); | FString FPaths::ChangeExtension(const FString& InPath, const FString& InNewExtension); | void FPaths::Split(const FString& InPath, FString& PathPart, FString& FilenamePart, FString& ExtensionPart); | bool FPaths::FileExists(const FString& InPath);
